turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Hi Sofia! How is your Wednesday going? How are things in Tucson, and how is Dash doing?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hey! Things are pretty good here. Dash is doing well, just sleeping on his bed as usual. I'm doing alright, though I was a bit tired this morning. I ended up just making a standard mug of brewed black coffee from my coffee maker before heading out.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: A classic mug of coffee is always a reliable way to wake up! Did you have a smooth commute to the clinic today?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yeah, it wasn't too bad. I took my hybrid car today instead of public transit, so I got to work pretty quickly and avoided the worst of the traffic.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That's great! It's nice having that car for a quick drive when you need it. Did you listen to anything interesting on the way?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I actually did! I listened to a show where they explain how to handle leash reactivity and positive reinforcement for pups. It's been really helpful to think about with Dash, even if he's already pretty relaxed.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Oh, a canine behavior show! That sounds super useful for greyhound life. Did you manage to get a good lunch break today?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I did. I brought some lunch from home today. I made a turkey and cheese sandwich using a couple of slices of the wild-yeast loaf I baked earlier this week.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Ah, homemade sourdough! There's really nothing better than a sandwich made with your own fresh-baked bread. Have you been doing a lot of baking lately?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes, I've been trying to keep up with my starter. It's been really active, so I've been baking about once a week. Tom has been loving it too, he's always happy to help eat whatever I make.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Tom is definitely lucky to have a live-in baker! Speaking of Tom, how are the wedding plans for next summer coming along?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: They're going well! We are slowly getting things organized, but we're mostly just enjoying being engaged right now and not stressing too much about the details yet.
